title: Feasibility of Online MR-guided Radiotherapy on a 1.5T MR-Linac
official: Feasibility of Imaging and Radiotherapy on a Novel 1.5 T Hybrid Magnetic Resonance Imaging - Linear Accelerator System (MR-Linac)
summary: This study investigates the feasibility of imaging and treatment on a novel 1.5 T MR-Linac radiotherapy hybrid device.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* existing indication for radiation therapy
* minimum age 18 years, no upper age limit
* capacity for consent
* Informed consent

Exclusion Criteria:

* contraindication for MRI (claustrophobia, metallic implants not applicable for MRI
* pregnancy

sites.f: University Hospital Tübingen, Department of Radiation Oncology
